g.text: k2: a measured low-rate reference constrains the voltage gap
Recorded discharged Ah alignment is conditional; absolute SOC and inventory are unverified.
Voltage (V): measured 0.05C and 1C; saved model bulk OCV
Voltage differences (mV): compare the measured rate gap with model loss
Late model loss reaches 596.7 mV. Curves display-sampled; metrics use all original charge knots.
Mean: measured rate gap 249.38 mV; model loss 212.87 mV; static-reference difference +7.66 mV.
Bulk OCV lies below low-rate voltage over 45.41% of common charge, by up to 14.96 mV.
Both start conventions agree closely. Unknown history and temperature differences prevent unique causal attribution.
Catenaro and Onori, DOI 10.17632/kxsbr4x3j2.2, CC BY4.0. Historical 1C result: 55.003 mV, fails 50 mV gate.
